selection_basis: general public market history only; no engine-output tuning

winners.thesis: COVID-era digital-transformation deal boom + large-deal wins drove multi-year EPS compounding and sustained P/E re-rating (2020-25).
PSU-bank credit-cost normalization + corporate-book recovery drove the 2021-24 re-rating (~2.5x in 3 years).
Fluorochemicals/specialty-chemicals capex cycle + import substitution: multi-year re-rating, EPS 16.08 -> 64.27 FY18-22.
Domestic capex-cycle order-book boom + asset monetization / NWC discipline drove the 2021-25 run.
2W/4W ancillary (aluminium casting, suspension); OEM share gains + premiumization drove steady compounding FY19-24.

mediocrities.thesis: US generics price erosion 2017-19; MOSL Jan-2018: stock 'will remain range bound' (~Rs 2,000-3,000 band 2017-19).
Defensive FMCG; price range-bound Rs 400-560 across 2019-22 while EPS barely moved (8.17 -> 8.18) - flat/de-rating profile.
Auto slowdown + BS-VI transition; flat Rs 6,000-7,500 2018-21 while EPS declined 260.86 -> 145.30 FY18-21.
US FDA overhangs; price flat Rs 700-900 2017-21 even as EPS grew 41.36 -> 91.05 by FY21 - textbook de-rating.
